```yaml
name: Coverage (Scheduled / Merge)

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # daily at midnight UTC
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - main
    tags:
      - '*'

jobs:
  coverage:
    name: PHP ${{ matrix.php }} + ${{ matrix.db }} ${{ matrix.db_version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - php: 8.4
            db: mysql
            db_version: 8.4
          - php: 8.4
            db: mariadb
            db_version: 11.8
          - php: 8.2
            db: mysql
            db_version: 8.4
          - php: 8.2
            db: mariadb
            db_version: 11.8
          - php: 8.1
            db: mysql
            db_version: 8.4
          - php: 8.1
            db: mariadb
            db_version: 11.8
          - php: 8.0
            db: mysql
            db_version: 8.4
          - php: 8.0
            db: mariadb
            db_version: 11.8
          - php: 7.4
            db: mysql
            db_version: 8.4
          - php: 7.4
            db: mariadb
            db_version: 11.8
    services:
      db:
        image: ${{ matrix.db }}:${{ matrix.db_version }}
        ports:
          - 3306:3306
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
          MYSQL_DATABASE: openemr
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="mysqladmin ping -h localhost -u root -proot"
          --health-interval=10s
          --health-timeout=5s
          --health-retries=3
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: pdo_mysql, mbstring, json, xml, zip
          ini-values: memory_limit=-1
          coverage: xdebug
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Cache Composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install Composer dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          dependency-versions: highest
          composer-options: '--no-progress --no-suggest --prefer-dist'
          working-directory: .
          ignore-cache: false
          require-lock-file: true
          composer-filename: composer.json

      - name: Run PHPUnit tests with coverage
        uses: itznotabug/php-retry@v3
        with:
          command: |
            vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover=coverage.xml --log-junit=junit.xml
          max_attempts: 3
          retry_wait_seconds: 10
          test_dir: tests
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          job_id: ${{ github.job }}

      - name: Publish unit test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          files: junit.xml

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage.xml
          directory: .
          coverage-format: clover
          fail-ci-if-error: true
```
